journal_linkHelp.message: Create paused local bookkeeping from an explicitly selected catalog

journal_intro.message: Durable bookkeeping only. This page cannot recapture, execute, retry or schedule work.

journal_boundaryHelp.message: Create paused journal writes private provider/conversation identities and the exact catalog digest to this browser profile. They survive page and extension restarts. No titles, URLs, paths or conversation content are stored. This is not a backup or anonymization.

journal_scopeHelp.message: Catalog selection is not account binding, proof of recoverability, provider completeness or permission to recapture. Source archives and catalogs are never changed.

journal_recoveryHelp.message: Opening this page explicitly recovers journals to paused. Previously running attempts become unknown; nothing is dispatched or retried.

journal_limits.message: One canonical liska-snapshot-catalog/1 JSON, at most 1 MiB. At most 16 journals and 2,048 conversations per journal.

journal_cancellationHelp.message: Cancel/reset discards pending results, not an already committed journal or a browser download. Reload this page to reconcile uncertain persistence. No journal is deleted.

journal_privateExport.message: Private exports contain stable provider/conversation identifiers and evidence references. Save only to a location you trust.

journal_reading.message: Reading and validating exact catalog bytes…

journal_ready.message: Catalog validated. Review the counts, then explicitly create a paused journal.

journal_loaded.message: Local journals are paused. No execution authority was acquired.

journal_creating.message: Writing a paused journal to this browser profile…

journal_created.message: Paused journal committed locally. Nothing was captured or dispatched.

journal_cancelled.message: Pending view cancelled. Existing local journals and downloads are unchanged.

journal_error.message: Operation refused. No retry was made. Reload to reconcile local state.

journal_selection_invalid.message: Select exactly one readable catalog JSON.

journal_catalog_invalid.message: Not an exact canonical supported snapshot catalog.

journal_saving.message: Save As requested. Waiting for exact browser download completion…

journal_confirmed.message: The browser reports the JSON download completed. Disk bytes were not independently reread.

journal_failure.message: The browser reports the download failed. No retry was made.

journal_unknown.message: Download outcome is unknown. Check Downloads. No retry was made.

catalog_linkHelp.message: Read manifest metadata from one selected archive root without changing files

catalog_intro.message: Choose an archive root once to build a private, manifest-only catalog of existing snapshots. Nothing is saved automatically.

catalog_boundary.message: Read-only catalog — every selected file stays unchanged.

catalog_boundaryHelp.message: Raw responses, canonical content and assets are not read. Only manifest.json files are read; other selected files contribute path and size metadata only. No provider access or archive changes are made.

catalog_privacyHelp.message: The downloaded JSON includes stable provider conversation identifiers. Hashing is not anonymization. Keep this report private. Folder names, relative paths, titles, URLs and conversation content are not exported.

catalog_completenessHelp.message: Completeness is declared manifest metadata, not verification of raw, canonical or asset bytes. Listed artifacts are not proof that their contents are intact.

catalog_limits.message: Up to 4,096 selected files and 128 manifests; 256 KiB per manifest and 8 MiB of manifests total. Metadata limits: 1 TiB per file, 8 TiB total. Paths are limited to 512 characters. Folder names and file paths are not displayed.

catalog_selected.message: Ready to catalog selected manifest metadata.

catalog_ready.message: Catalog complete. No selected files were changed.

catalog_cancelled.message: Catalog cancelled. No report was saved.

catalog_cancellationHelp.message: Cancel takes effect between manifest reads and discards late work. Synchronous manifest parsing cannot stop instantly. Clear forgets this page’s selection and report.

catalog_error.message: The catalog could not finish. No report was saved.

catalog_selection_invalid.message: Choose one archive root with intact, safe relative paths. This selection is invalid or ambiguous.

catalog_selection_limit.message: The selection exceeds a catalog file, manifest, path or byte limit. Choose a smaller archive root.

catalog_selection_read_failed.message: A selected manifest could not be read completely. Select the archive root again.

catalog_directory_unavailable.message: This browser does not provide directory selection. No flat-file fallback is used.

catalog_noEntries.message: No supported snapshot manifests were cataloged.

catalog_saving.message: Save As requested. Waiting for browser completion…

catalog_confirmed.message: The browser reports the JSON download completed. Disk bytes were not independently reread.

catalog_failure.message: The browser did not complete the catalog download. No retry was made. Clear or select again before another deliberate attempt.

catalog_unknown.message: Download outcome is unknown. Check Downloads. No retry was made. Clear or select again before another deliberate attempt.

snapshot_intro.message: Inspect saved snapshots without changing them. Add each snapshot folder separately, then compare the selected bytes locally.

snapshot_boundaryHelp.message: Even identical bytes do not authorize cleanup. Links outside your selection are not checked. This page cannot delete, move, or overwrite source files.

snapshot_supported.message: Current ChatGPT web snapshots only. Other formats, incomplete captures, and extra files remain preserved and may be unverifiable.

snapshot_limits.message: Choose 2–16 snapshot folders. Up to 256 files per folder, 1,024 files total, 64 MiB per file and 256 MiB total. Folder names and source text are not displayed.

snapshot_selected.message: Ready to analyze after at least two folders are selected.

snapshot_analyzing.message: Checking bytes, provenance, and canonical replay…

snapshot_ready.message: Analysis complete. No source files were changed.

snapshot_cancelled.message: Analysis cancelled. No report was saved.

snapshot_cancellationHelp.message: Cancel takes effect between reads and hashes; synchronous parsing cannot stop instantly. Peak memory can exceed selected file sizes.

snapshot_error.message: Analysis could not finish. No report was saved.

snapshot_selection_invalid.message: Choose a single snapshot folder with intact relative paths. This selection is invalid or ambiguous.

snapshot_selection_limit.message: The selection exceeds a file, folder, or byte limit. Choose a smaller set.

snapshot_selection_read_failed.message: A selected file could not be read completely. Select the folder again.

snapshot_directory_unavailable.message: This browser does not provide directory selection. No flat-file fallback is used.

snapshot_noRelations.message: No comparable candidate relationships were found. Keep every snapshot.

snapshot_saving.message: Save As requested. Waiting for browser completion…

snapshot_confirmed.message: The browser reports the JSON download completed. Disk bytes were not independently reread.

snapshot_failure.message: The browser did not complete the report download. No automatic retry was made.

snapshot_unknown.message: Download outcome is unknown. Check Downloads before any deliberate new attempt. Reset or analyze again to enable Save.

settings_inertCodeBlocksHelp.message: In emitted File, Clipboard, and Obsidian reading notes, every language-tagged Markdown fence is shown as plain literal source with its original fence, info string, content, and closing fence visible. Ambiguous fence-like syntax is refused instead of saved. This disables syntax highlighting and special rendering. Raw/canonical archives and canonical HTML stay unchanged. Append refuses a pre-existing tagged block. This does not protect inline syntax, raw HTML, general postprocessors, or plugins that read files.

reconcile_intro.message: Reconcile one saved web canonical snapshot with the matching conversation in an official ChatGPT export. Everything is processed in this local extension page.

reconcile_webCanonicalHelp.message: Select canonical/liska-thread-1.json from an existing Liska web capture.

reconcile_officialExportHelp.message: Select conversations.json, or all conversations-NNN.json shards together. Liska validates every selected array but retains only the exact matching conversation.

reconcile_officialManifestHelp.message: For shards only, separately select export_manifest.json (up to 2 MiB) to check that its declared shard names match your selection. This does not verify shard contents or export completeness. The export manifest is not saved.

reconcile_boundaryShards.message: Validate every selected conversation shard. An optional separately selected export manifest checks declared shard names only; without it, missing shards cannot be inferred.

reconcile_boundaryBundle.message: Ask where to save one immutable ZIP. It always preserves official raw and manifest; canonical and comparison are included only when normalization succeeds.

reconcile_saveLocation.message: A browser file selection does not grant write access to the source folder. Choose that folder in the Save As dialog if you want the bundle beside your snapshots.
